plan.subtitle: 计划、逐页生成、终处理与落位
plan.visual_solution: Build one quiet left-to-right editorial route with three unequal stations. First: a short source sheet with only three abstract ink lines, one circled relation skeleton, and no readable prose, Markdown syntax, source excerpt, or extra text. Second: a single finished explanatory image page emerges from that skeleton, with no duplicate image. Third: an article sheet or presentation rail shows that same image seated at one unique insertion mark, with a tiny finished logo reserve in the upper-right of the image. Render only the declared title, subtitle, and three local label strings; do not render any other explanatory paragraph. Use only two thin directional connectors, one tiny green transition mark, and no hand, dashboard, card wall, or repeated document piles.

plan.intent: make the reader-visible difference between content placement and visual explanation legible
plan.source_anchor: | 普通 AI PPT 的默认路径 | smkt-article-visual 的路径 |
plan.reader_block: A reader should see that the distinction is not more or less information: one alternative leaves relationships for the audience to reconstruct, while the other makes one relationship visibly understandable on the page.
plan.source_relation: A prompt or file can become content filling and template layout, or an existing judgment can become a reader block, visual explanation, and a sequence of explainable pages.
plan.subtitle: 把内容放上去，还是让对方看见关系
plan.visual_solution: Use two deliberately unequal abstract editorial arrangements, not a UI and not a card wall. On the left, one small source sheet releases three detached, similarly weighted ink text strips with no grouping relation; their uneven gaps leave the reader to mentally reconstruct the connection. On the right, one comparable source sheet leads into one compact explanatory field: three distinctly shaped ink elements are visibly held in one thin, non-directional gray relation structure, with one small green focus ring around the shared relationship. Keep both alternatives as small shallow paper-like editorial forms in one asymmetric cluster; do not depict software, screens, dashboards, people, or arrows.
must_show: the left alternative shows source content separated into detached, similarly weighted fragments with no visible relationship
the right alternative shows one compact relationship structure whose connected elements remain visibly grouped without its label
the alternatives differ through object grouping and connection, not merely through labels or colour
must_not_imply: that either alternative invents source facts, data, or causal proof
that the output is an editable presentation application or software interface
that more visual decoration alone produces understanding
comparison_basis: the content-filling alternative is visibly dispersed into detached equal-weight fragments with no grouping relation
the visual-explanation alternative is visibly organized as one grouped relationship with connected, differently positioned elements

local_colours.target: the small focus ring around the shared relationship in the visual-explanation alternative
local_colours.rationale: make the one source-supported visible relationship easy to locate without using colour as the proof

visible_evidence: the left side remains three detached equal-weight fragments while the right side is one connected relation field
the different grouping and connection remain legible when the title, subtitle, labels, and notes are hidden

scene_integrity.rationale: the page compares two source-derived information arrangements without depicting a person, software interface, or real-world scene
